payload.source: GirderDetail Structural analysis, G1 (exterior), staged, variable stiffness (steel / 3n / n)
notes: Forces of girder G1 (exterior) from GirderDetail's Structural analysis, staged, variable stiffness (steel / 3n / n) line-girder model, continuous. Unfactored: no load factors are applied.

DC1 = steel, deck, haunch and other noncomposite dead load on the steel section (girder self-weight included); DC2 and DW on the long-term composite section. DC1 split (optional fields): M_DC1steel/V_DC1steel = girder flanges and web at 490 pcf × (1 + 5% detail allowance for stiffeners, connection plates and splices) plus the cross-frames and diaphragms as point loads at this girder's frames (17 loads, 2.80 kip in all; K-frames (diagonals meet at the bottom chord), h = 52.00 in: top chord L5x5x3/8, bottom chord L3x3x3/8, diagonals L3x3x3/8; end frames X-type with the same angles; member lengths work point to work point + 10% for gusset plates and bolts); M_DC1wet/V_DC1wet = deck, haunch, SIP forms and any other DC1 rows of the LLDF and DLs module (0.895 klf); both on the steel section, simultaneous (no pour sequence); M_DC1 = their sum (±0.001 rounding).

LL+IM = HL-93 per girder: already multiplied by this girder's distribution factors (multiple presence and skew correction included), IM 33% on the truck and tandem only. The receiver must not apply distribution factors again.

Fatigue (M_FAT, V_FAT) = fatigue truck (3.6.1.4.1) with IM 15% and the single-lane fatigue distribution factors (no multiple presence), unfactored (gamma not applied). Range = positive minus negative.
The pedestrian load is ADDED to LL+IM (as GirderDetail does for its own design demands); M_PL/V_PL give it separately.

Moments sagging positive. Shears in the MIDAS convention of this schema (negative at the left end of a span under gravity load). Shear at a node is the element just right of it; at each interior support there is one station 0.001 ft either side.
Not sent: construction live load, deck placement sequence, wind and flange lateral bending.

Owner load rules of RIDOT (OWN6–OWN8), applied in GirderDetail's own checks, are NOT in these unfactored forces: design load multiplier 1.2 on HL-93 LL+IM at the Strength and Service limit states (not on the pedestrian load); load modifier eta = 1.050 on the Strength load factors (1/eta on the minimum factors); haunch taken as 0 in composite section properties (deck.haunch is the haunch as entered; the forces come from an analysis with the haunch at 0 in the composite stiffness). They are sent in ownerRules; ST-Girder applies them to its own checks.

ownerRules.codeBasis: AASHTO LRFD 10th Ed. (2024) with the owner rules on top

llMultiplier.liveLoad: HL-93 LL+IM only; not the pedestrian load

eta.cite: RIDOT BDM 1.3.1; RIDOT BDM 1.3.2; RIDOT BDM 1.3.3
eta.rule: maximum Strength load factors x max; minimum factors x min (AASHTO LRFD 1.3.2.1)

ratingTarget.basis: HL-93 inventory design-load rating, AASHTO factors without m or eta

bracing.source: Cross-frames module input L_b (spacing of the intermediate cross-frames)
